scope: Closed preparation and source-review observations only. Exact-source final native, source and real-model campaigns are excluded until the root explicitly confirms terminal results.
archive_extension_policy: Append .txt to source, Cargo manifests/locks, runners, .log and original Markdown; preserve every original byte and map original paths externally. Collector creates no README.

closed_preparation_scope_notes.limit_failure: Synthetic harness native pending-Task admission refusal (6 of 7 tests passed), not a real-model operation.
closed_preparation_scope_notes.wirecache_failure: Synthetic example harness 128-record wire-manifest cache refusal (6 of 7 tests passed), not a real-model operation.
closed_preparation_scope_notes.source_owner_report: version_contract_audit independently confirmed the preparation paths terminal and reported no true-model launch by that agent.
closed_preparation_scope_notes.original_manifests: Preserve all original bytes, including the seven-file precursor source/reconstruction and diagnostics' 23-source precommit delta. No later source substitutes for failed source.
closed_preparation_scope_notes.unexecuted_controls: Excluded until independently confirmed; prepared controller text alone is never execution evidence.
